title: No loading feedback for ~640 ms after tapping nav bar (Edge Finder/Slate): skeleton only appears after the first RSC response
persona: User on slow 3G (400 kbps, 400 ms RTT, 4x CPU)
steps: Tap EDGES in the nav bar
expected: Immediate pending state (skeleton or progress) on tap
actual: At 250 ms the old slate is still shown with only the nav label highlighted, no skeleton or spinner. Skeleton ([aria-busy]) first appeared 637 ms after tap for /edges (106 ms for /slate, which was already in the router cache); full content at 1160 ms. Nav links, sport tabs, view toggles and game links all use prefetch={false}, so loading.tsx is never prefetched and appears only once the server round trip returns. Slate->game: 749 ms, skeleton never observed.
evidence: evidence/SLO-001.png; script run output: nav Edge Finder skeletonAtMs=637, ms=1160, 2 requests 7.3 KB
suspected_area: prefetch={false} on chrome.tsx nav / sport-tabs; no useLinkStatus/pending indicator
